events.label: Quote sent
events.when: As soon as you send a quote
events.body:
Hi Asha, bekbake has sent you a quote for your cake: Rs. 1,499.

Tap below to see the details and accept it. Reply to this message if you'd like to change anything.

events.label: Order ready
events.when: When you mark an order ready
events.body:
Hi Asha, your cake from bekbake is ready.

Pickup: 20 September 2026, 2:30 PM

Reply to this message if you need to change anything.

events.label: Order taken
events.when: When you write down an order for a customer yourself
events.body:
Hi Asha, bekbake has taken down your cake order.

Size: 1.5 kg
Flavour: Chocolate, Vanilla
Home delivery: 20 September 2026, 2:30 PM

Tap below to check everything is right and add your email for updates.

events.label: Order confirmed
events.body:
Hi Asha, your cake order with bekbake is confirmed. Total: Rs. 1,499.

We'll message you again when it's ready.

events.label: Design updated
events.when: Each time you change a design
events.body:
Hi Asha, bekbake has updated the design for your cake.

Tap below to take a look. Reply to this message if you'd like anything changed.

events.label: Thank you
events.when: When you mark an order complete
events.body:
Thank you for ordering from bekbake, Asha. We hope your cake made the moment special.

Wishing you many more celebrations.
